segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let text = "The American Red Cross was established in Washington, D.C., by Clara Barton." let tagger = NLTagger(tagSchemes: [.nameType]) tagger.string = text let options: NLTagger.Options = [.omitPunctuation, .omitWhitespace, .joinNames] let tags: [NLTag] = [.personalName, .placeName, .organizationName] tagger.enumerateTags(in: text.startIndex..<text.endIndex, unit: .word, scheme: .nameType, options: options) { tag, tokenRange in // Get the most likely tag, and print it if it's a named entity. if let tag = tag, tags.contains(tag) { print("\(text[tokenRange]): \(tag.rawValue)") } // Get multiple possible tags with their associated confidence scores. let (hypotheses, _) = tagger.tagHypotheses(at: tokenRange.lowerBound, unit: .word, scheme: .nameType, maximumCount: 1) print(hypotheses) return true } ```
